cook_steak.description: Sear steak in pan, flip once, serve on plate on dining table, hob off.
cook_steak.notes: Steak starts on the board. Pour board into pan while pan is cold on the hob, then press hob on (hand must be free). Spatula 'use pan' flip only works when standing close, at about (3.2,1.3) facing the hob. go_to hob left me too far, and the flip failed there. Check with inspect steak. The underside browns in about 40s, so flip then. After the flip the core rose about 0.5C/s (37C to 49C in about 50s). I flipped late and took it off at 49C, which is rare. For medium, wait until about 55C before hob off. Pour the pan straight onto the plate on the dining table. Flip earlier, about 30s after the pour.

cook_steak_v2.description: Sear steak, flip once, serve on dining table plate, hob off. Worked: 59C medium.
cook_steak_v2.notes: Flip with go_to hob then use pan (worked from (2.9,1.5)); walk_to (3.2,1.3) failed 'couldn't bring spatula' repeatedly, and shuffles did not change facing. Each action costs ~10-30s sim time, so the steak was flipped late (core 43C, underside browned, top raw). After flip core 47C; I turned the hob off right away, put spatula down, carried pan; by the plate the steak was 59C (medium). Residual heat adds ~10C. Turn hob off at ~47C after the flip. Inspect steak before flip to decide timing.

lessons: Steak burns fast once pan is hot (pan preheated while I fetched board/spatula; ~1 min of waiting then flip burned the top). Pan on hob only after steak is ready; check inspect every ~15s; take off at ~58C inside.

Steak: the side against the pan keeps cooking/burns; core heats slowly (~0.25C/s, 55C after ~160s from flip). Flip more often (every ~30s) so neither side blackens, and take pan off the heat at ~50C (hob off earlier; residual heat adds ~10C). Use spatula 'use pan' to flip. Moving the steak out with spatula to the plate early is better than carrying the hot pan.
